resources.string: MAYA AutoSend: jab Maya WhatsApp message draft kare to khud send dabati hai. Sirf WhatsApp ke send button tak limited.

Maya reviewed browser navigation: only explicitly approved public-page OPEN and SCROLL plans in a selected supported browser. No idle screen collection, page-text upload, taps, typing, messages, installs or payments. Persistent STOP notification required.

Maya reviewed WhatsApp type: only an explicitly approved chat OPEN plus one TYPE of your exact reviewed text. Never presses SEND — you check the chat and send it yourself. Never overwrites an existing draft. No idle screen collection, chat reading, taps, other apps or payments. Persistent STOP notification required.
